name: ui
display_name: TF2 hit and kill dings, freeze cam
sounds_provenance: TF2's own 'Default' hit sound and kill sound (tf_dingalingaling). Open Halo plays 'hit' when your shot damages someone and 'kill' when it kills them; without this pack it synthesizes a plain ding. 'freeze' plays as the killcam swoops to your killer, 'snapshot' as it freezes.
